title: The Eriksson Programme (Yang-Mills): Machine-Checked Lattice Gauge Foundations, Certified Obstructions, and the Open Frontier
abstract: We present an archival technical synthesis and handoff specification for the Yang-Mills formalization programme inside THE-ERIKSSON-PROGRAMME (archival release yang-mills-archive-v1.0). The repository pins Lean 4 (v4.29.0-rc6) and mathlib (07642720480157414db592fa85b626dafb71355b) and maintains a continuously verified core module, YangMillsCore, whose build and axiom oracle pass in GitHub Actions with zero sorry declarations, zero project-specific axioms, and every headline declaration restricted to Lean's three foundational axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Within this verified core, the programme establishes a reusable Kotecky-Preiss and Mayer-Ursell polymer cluster-expansion engine, finite-volume and volume-uniform strong-coupling Wilson-loop area laws and unconditional IR clustering for SU(N) without Peter-Weyl, exact Z_N centre-symmetry rules, machine-checked Amos/Bessel ratio bounds and killed von Mises bridge monotonicity, complete Z_2 Osterwalder-Seiler chains, and certified negative obstructions. No four-dimensional continuum limit, physical SU(N) OS/Wightman reconstruction, or Clay Millennium Prize solution is claimed; historical Clay distance remains ~0% (<0.1%). Open frontiers (hRpoly in draft PR #29, physical SU(N) reflection positivity/transfer, and M4-M5 continuum reconstruction) and 30+ AIRR records are indexed in one citable archival record.

ai_assistance.statement: Large language models assisted manuscript preparation and Lean 4 formalization under author supervision. Core mathematical claims are verified by the Lean 4 kernel with standard axioms only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Independent frontier-model assessments are recorded separately in registry/model-assessments.json.

conflicts: The author owns and administers AIRR; no independent editorial admission is claimed.
editorial.statement: Public working-paper deposit authorized by the author for this exact version. Independent OpenRouter frontier-model assessments are recorded for the exact canonical PDF hash. No AIRR accepted-collection admission or independent human peer review is claimed.

technical_note.scope_statement: Archival technical synthesis and 2027 continuation handoff indexing the Lean 4 verified YangMillsCore substrate, certified negative obstructions, frozen open frontiers (hRpoly PR #29, physical SU(N) reflection positivity/transfer, and M4-M5 continuum reconstruction), and 30+ companion AIRR preprints at release yang-mills-archive-v1.0.
technical_note.limitations: This note proves no new mathematical theorem beyond summarizing the verified Lean 4 core and companion records. It explicitly does not claim a four-dimensional continuum limit (a -> 0), physical SU(N) Osterwalder-Schrader or Wightman reconstruction, or any solution to the Clay Millennium Yang-Mills Mass Gap problem (Clay distance remains ~0%, <0.1%).
